causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Actual demand was close to forecast four hours ahead, and around 900 MW greater than forecast 12 hours ahead while actual availability was around 400 MW lower for the same periods.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The situation was further exacerbated by the forced shutdown of Liddell unit 3.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: N_X_MBTE2_B Outage of two Directlink cables, limits flows on Terranora from Qld to NSW - Terranora

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: The reduction in offered ramp rates prolonged the effect of the constraint by taking longer to ramp the units down to the point where the constraint is relieved and prices reduce.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: During the 2 pm trading interval four system normal constraints were binding, reducing imports into New South Wales and constraining down local generation.
